name: qixxx
description: A QIX clone game written in TypeScript

scripts.ranking:local:show: wrangler d1 execute qixxx-scores --local --command "SELECT rank_seq, score, stage, name, status, datetime(created_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS created FROM scores ORDER BY score DESC"
scripts.ranking:local:clear-pending: wrangler d1 execute qixxx-scores --local --command "DELETE FROM scores WHERE status='pending'"
scripts.ranking:local:reset: wrangler d1 execute qixxx-scores --local --command "DELETE FROM scores"
scripts.ranking:local:audit: RANKING_IP_HASH_KEY=$(grep RANKING_IP_HASH_KEY .dev.vars | cut -d= -f2) npx vite-node scripts/audit/cli.ts
